selection: All integrated FXR records, including negative annotations; one canonical isomeric SMILES per row.
property_method: Largest organic component by heavy-atom count, then molecular weight; no neutralization or tautomer changes. Original full SMILES retained.
scaffold_method: RDKit Bemis-Murcko ring/linker frameworks of the same property component; stereochemistry excluded only from scaffold grouping; acyclic molecules have an empty scaffold.
resource_id_policy: Sequential 1..7652 after moving the default 20 complete active preview records to the front. Search, preview and downloads use the same IDs; query results retain these IDs.
activity_display_policy: A positive task is displayed as FXR agonist / FXR antagonist. Inactive means no positive annotation among available tasks; blank task labels remain unannotated.

display_label_overrides.authority: FXR_AGO.csv label=1; no corresponding record in FXR_ANT.csv
display_label_overrides.note: Display follows the existing benchmark. External antagonist evidence remains in raw resource records; absence from the antagonist benchmark is not encoded as a negative label.
